zh-CN.title: 后端权威层
zh-CN.requirement: EQ 报告的分数、解读、机制、场景、职业环境、下一步练习重点和科学边界必须来自后端 content pack 与 Eq60ReportComposer。前端和 Agent 只能消费已经解析的报告内容。
zh-CN.acceptance: report payload、canonical fixtures 和 contract tests 能证明前端无需硬编码正式报告解释，也不能覆盖后端选择结果。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 这是内容与报告权威边界，不是新的评分规则、诊断结论或能力认证。

en.title: Backend authority layer
en.requirement: EQ scores, interpretation, mechanisms, scenes, career-environment variables, action guidance, and scientific boundaries must come from the backend content pack and Eq60ReportComposer. The frontend and Agent may only consume resolved report content.
en.acceptance: Report payloads, canonical fixtures, and contract tests demonstrate that the frontend does not hardcode official report interpretation and cannot override backend-selected outcomes.
en.do_not_overread: This is an authority boundary for content and report delivery, not a new scoring rule, diagnostic claim, or credential.

meta.purpose: Backend authority, delivery, and safety contract for EQ report assets
meta.risk_notes: Internal contract asset. Do not treat as scoring, diagnostic, personnel-screening, medical, credentialing, SJT availability, commerce, or frontend-authoritative content.

zh-CN.title: Schema 映射
zh-CN.requirement: 每个 EQ 资产文件必须映射到 content-pack compiler 可识别的结构，并保留稳定 内容 ID、locale 字段、风险边界和触发逻辑。
zh-CN.acceptance: content:lint、content:compile、mirror drift check、canonical fixtures 和 report contract tests 通过后，资产才能进入报告 payload。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: Schema 通过只说明资产结构可读，不代表内容可用于医疗、人事、能力认证或绩效判断。

en.title: Schema mapping
en.requirement: Each EQ content file must map into compiler-readable content-pack structure while preserving stable content IDs, locale fields, risk boundaries, and trigger logic.
en.acceptance: content may enter the report payload only after content lint, content compile, mirror drift checks, canonical fixtures, and report contract tests pass.
en.do_not_overread: A passing schema means the content is structurally readable; it does not make the content suitable for medical, personnel, credentialing, or performance decisions.

meta.purpose: Backend authority, delivery, and safety contract for EQ report assets
meta.risk_notes: Internal contract asset. Do not treat as scoring, diagnostic, personnel-screening, medical, credentialing, SJT availability, commerce, or frontend-authoritative content.

zh-CN.title: Resolved 内容 合同
zh-CN.requirement: 用户可见解释应优先使用 内容 中已解析的本地化内容；内容_refs 只作为可追踪引用，不应直接显示给用户。
zh-CN.acceptance: zh-CN 与 en fixtures 都能返回对应 locale 的 resolved 内容，且页面不展示 raw 内容 ID、阅读顺序 ID、technical tag 或内部调试字段。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 内容_refs 不是正式文案；缺失 resolved 内容 时应降级为空态或保守提示，而不是让前端编造解释。

en.title: Resolved content contract
en.requirement: User-visible interpretation should prefer localized content already resolved under content; content_refs are traceable references and should not be rendered directly to users.
en.acceptance: Both zh-CN and en fixtures return matching localized resolved content, and result pages do not show raw content IDs, route IDs, technical tags, or internal debug fields.
en.do_not_overread: content_refs are not official copy. If resolved content are missing, the surface should fail closed or show a conservative unavailable state rather than inventing interpretation in the frontend.

meta.purpose: Backend authority, delivery, and safety contract for EQ report assets
meta.risk_notes: Internal contract asset. Do not treat as scoring, diagnostic, personnel-screening, medical, credentialing, SJT availability, commerce, or frontend-authoritative content.

zh-CN.title: Canonical fixtures
zh-CN.requirement: 至少维护 balanced、high_empathy_low_recovery、low_confidence 与代表性 阅读顺序 路径的 zh-CN / en payload 样本。
zh-CN.acceptance: fixtures 覆盖 all-free、低置信、阅读顺序 selection、resolved 内容、SJT planned/unavailable、无权限门槛和无 raw tag 泄漏。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: fixture 是合同样本，不是常模样本，也不是用户分布或科学验证证据。

en.title: Canonical fixtures
en.requirement: Maintain zh-CN and en payload samples for at least balanced, high_empathy_low_recovery, low_confidence, and one representative route-selection path.
en.acceptance: Fixtures cover all-free access, low-confidence handling, route selection, resolved content, SJT planned/unavailable, no access wall, and no raw-tag leakage.
en.do_not_overread: A fixture is a contract sample, not a norm sample, user distribution, or validation study.

meta.purpose: Backend authority, delivery, and safety contract for EQ report assets
meta.risk_notes: Internal contract asset. Do not treat as scoring, diagnostic, personnel-screening, medical, credentialing, SJT availability, commerce, or frontend-authoritative content.

zh-CN.title: 契约测试
zh-CN.requirement: contract tests 必须断言 EQ report payload 包含当前版本资产、分数/维度摘要、质量解释、解释选择、科学边界、免费访问状态与 SJT unavailable 状态。
zh-CN.acceptance: 测试失败时不得通过前端 fallback、Agent fallback 或静态文案绕过后端资产合同。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 契约测试保护交付形状和边界，不证明测验具备临床、招聘或能力评估效度。

en.title: Contract tests
en.requirement: Contract tests must assert that the EQ report payload includes current-version content, score and dimension summaries, quality explanation, interpretation selection, scientific boundaries, all-free access state, and SJT unavailable state.
en.acceptance: When these tests fail, the issue must not be bypassed with frontend fallback, Agent fallback, or static local report copy.
en.do_not_overread: Contract tests protect delivery shape and boundaries; they do not establish clinical, personnel-screening, or objective-capacity-assessment validity.

meta.purpose: Backend authority, delivery, and safety contract for EQ report assets
meta.risk_notes: Internal contract asset. Do not treat as scoring, diagnostic, personnel-screening, medical, credentialing, SJT availability, commerce, or frontend-authoritative content.

zh-CN.title: 前端消费契约
zh-CN.requirement: 前端只能渲染后端 resolved 内容 与 UI chrome。正式报告解释、科学边界、行动建议和职业环境变量不得在前端硬编码。
zh-CN.acceptance: 缺少资产、locale mismatch、guardrail 异常或 access 异常时，前端应 fail closed，不显示访问门槛入口、不显示技术 tag、不改写 解读。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 前端可以负责交互与布局，但不是报告内容、分数、职业判断或 Agent 回答的权威来源。

en.title: Frontend consumption contract
en.requirement: The frontend may render backend resolved content and UI chrome only. Official report interpretation, scientific boundaries, action guidance, and career-environment variables must not be hardcoded in frontend code.
en.acceptance: If content are missing, locale mismatched, guardrails unsafe, or access state anomalous, the frontend fails closed without showing commerce entry points, technical tags, or rewritten interpretations.
en.do_not_overread: The frontend owns interaction and layout; it is not the authority for report content, scores, career judgments, or Agent answers.

meta.purpose: Backend authority, delivery, and safety contract for EQ report assets
meta.risk_notes: Internal contract asset. Do not treat as scoring, diagnostic, personnel-screening, medical, credentialing, SJT availability, commerce, or frontend-authoritative content.

zh-CN.title: Agent 只读契约
zh-CN.requirement: Agent 只能基于 report_context、resolved_内容、retrieval tags、intent map 与 forbidden-claim metadata 做解释。它不能改分数、改 解读、改 section、开启 SJT、生成权限门槛，或替代后端报告权威。
zh-CN.acceptance: Agent context 与 runtime response 都返回 read_only=true，并明确 can_mutate_report=false、can_mutate_scores=false、can_override_解读=false、can_enable_sjt=false、can_expose_raw_technical_tags=false。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: Agent 是反思与解释辅助，不是治疗师、招聘评估者、能力测验评分员或第三方评价工具。

en.title: Read-only Agent contract
en.requirement: The Agent may explain only from report_context, resolved_content, retrieval tags, intent maps, and forbidden-claim metadata. It cannot change scores, change interpretations, change sections, enable SJT, create access gates, or replace backend report authority.
en.acceptance: Agent context and runtime responses return read_only=true and explicitly keep can_mutate_report=false, can_mutate_scores=false, can_override_interpretation=false, can_enable_sjt=false, and can_expose_raw_technical_tags=false.
en.do_not_overread: The Agent is a reflection and explanation aid, not a therapist, personnel evaluator, objective-capacity scorer, or third-party assessment tool.

meta.purpose: Backend authority, delivery, and safety contract for EQ report assets
meta.risk_notes: Internal contract asset. Do not treat as scoring, diagnostic, personnel-screening, medical, credentialing, SJT availability, commerce, or frontend-authoritative content.

zh-CN.title: 内部字段边界
zh-CN.requirement: report_tags、quality_level、bucket、focus、阅读顺序_id、内容_ref、scoring internals 与 debug 字段只能用于选择、审计或测试，不得作为用户可见解释文本。
zh-CN.acceptance: 用户可见 payload 和页面必须通过 resolved 内容 展示自然语言；raw IDs 只允许出现在内部追踪、fixture 或调试上下文中。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 内部字段不是用户标签，也不是人格类型、能力等级、职业适配结论或关系质量判断。

en.title: Internal field boundary
en.requirement: report_tags, quality_level, bucket, focus, route_id, content_ref, scoring internals, and debug fields may be used for selection, audit, or tests only; they must not become user-visible interpretation copy.
en.acceptance: User-visible payloads and result pages present natural language through resolved content. Raw IDs are limited to internal tracing, fixtures, or debugging contexts.
en.do_not_overread: Internal fields are not user labels, personality types, ability levels, job-fit conclusions, or relationship-quality judgments.

meta.purpose: Backend authority, delivery, and safety contract for EQ report assets
meta.risk_notes: Internal contract asset. Do not treat as scoring, diagnostic, personnel-screening, medical, credentialing, SJT availability, commerce, or frontend-authoritative content.

zh-CN.title: SJT 与访问边界
zh-CN.requirement: EQ-SJT 在实现前必须保持 planned/unavailable；EQ-60 报告当前保持 all-free，不得用交易、等级访问或权限门槛解释报告深度。
zh-CN.acceptance: next_module.available=false，SJT 不提供 take entry；report-access 与 report payload 保持 unlocked、full、all-free，offers 为空。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: SJT planned 只表示未来可能补充情境判断模块，不表示当前报告已经测量真实情绪能力或认证能力。

en.title: SJT and access boundary
en.requirement: EQ-SJT remains planned/unavailable until implemented. The EQ-60 report remains all-free, and report depth must not be framed as purchase-based or tier-based access.
en.acceptance: next_module.available=false, no SJT take entry is exposed, and report-access/report payloads remain unlocked, full, all-free, with empty offers.
en.do_not_overread: SJT planned means a future scenario-judgment module may complement self-report; it does not mean the current report measures objective emotional capacity or certified capacity.
